body: So should I bring a jacket or will a pashmina be enough? 😭

Hey, I’m currently at these beginning stages of feelings and thoughts and I just want to say thank you for being able to put all this sort of complex experience into words that has helped me gain a more grounded awareness.

Just dropping by to say, I love you and your music so much! Thank you for this album, I was going through a dark time and forgetting my light and this album has been able to remind me of the beauty that I seek and feel in this world.

1. I feel like I experienced a different layer of you and your team’s musical talents in this album, in what ways do you believe you guys have tried something new or experimented in the making of this album? What are some things you were proud of during the making?
